reviews.text: Very happy with my HVAC system, price and service. Dick Schnader is a straight-up guy who has very, very fair pricing. Highly recommend.

reviews.text: Called and told him what was going on, tech was at the house in 5 minutes, repaired the problem in 10 minutes. Fairly priced, nicely done!!!
reviews.author: christopher T.

reviews.text: I want to thank 'Junie' for helping me out with an air conditioning malfunction. I have a disability that makes it difficult to manage my pain and function in heat and humidity.
